title: What to put in the "Experience" section of LinkedIn
description: Part 11 of our LinkedIn profile optimization series—this time focused on the “experience” section. Reminder that you should showcase your achievements and not just your job responsibilities. Watch to the end for our go-to formula for crafting achievements for your LinkedIn profile and resume. Google “Teal Chrome extension” to get started! #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #careeradvice
